info.description: Backend for the Birga caregiver app.
info.title: Birga API

get.description: Checks that the database is reachable.

post.description:
- title/description are required in both Uzbek (uz) and Russian (ru)
- goal is one of: language, motor, cognitive, social, emotional
- min_age/max_age are child ages in years, within 2..6

- phone_number is required, in E.164 format (+998901234567)
- username is optional: 3..32 latin letters, digits, '_' or '.'; stored lowercase
- name is optional, at most 100 characters; photo_id is an optional id from POST /v1/media (422 if unknown)
- username and phone_number must be unique among non-deleted users (409)

delete.description:
Sets deleted_at; the user disappears from reads, their tokens are removed,
and their username and phone number can be used again.

patch.description:
- only the fields present in the body change; omitted or null fields are kept
- "" clears name, username or photo_id; phone_number cannot be cleared
- same format and uniqueness rules as create

post.description:
- refresh_token must be signed by this API, unexpired, of type refresh, and still the
one stored for the user (a deleted user's token stops working); otherwise 401
- the refresh token is not rotated; keep using it until it expires
post.summary: trades a refresh token for a new access token

post.description:
- the phone number must be verified first: POST /v1/otp/send and /v1/otp/verify with
purpose sign_up; the verification lasts OTP_VERIFIED_TTL (default 10 minutes) and is
used up by a successful sign-up. Not verified: 403
- name: 1 to 100 characters; username: 3 to 32 of a-z, 0-9, '_' or '.' (lowercased);
password: 8 to 72 bytes, stored as a bcrypt hash; phone_number: +998 and 9 digits (422)
- username or phone number already used: 409
- access_token (JWT_ACCESS_TTL, default 15 minutes) and refresh_token (JWT_REFRESH_TTL,
default 30 days) are HS256 JWTs; send the access token as Authorization: Bearer <token>
post.summary: creates a user and returns their tokens

post.description:
- send form data (multipart/form-data or application/x-www-form-urlencoded) with one field "file":
either the file itself (multipart file part) or the file as a base64 string; a data URL
prefix such as "data:image/png;base64," is allowed
- accepted: JPEG, PNG or WebP, detected from the bytes, not from the file name (422 otherwise)
- at most MEDIA_MAX_SIZE bytes after decoding, default 5 MiB (422 otherwise)
- the answer's id goes into users.photo_id (PATCH /v1/admin/users/{id} {"photo_id": id});
url is where clients load the image from
- 503 when S3 is not configured (S3_BUCKET empty)
post.summary: uploads an image (a profile photo) to S3

parameters.description: the image: a file part, or a base64 string in the same field
parameters.name: file

post.description:
- phone_number: an Uzbek mobile number in E.164, +998 and 9 digits (422 otherwise)
- purpose: sign_up (the number must not belong to a user, 409 otherwise) or update_user
- ip_address: the end user's IPv4 or IPv6 address, used for rate limits
- the code has 6 digits and is sent through Play Mobile; only its hash is stored
- the code is kept in Redis for expires_in seconds (OTP_TTL, default 2 minutes); a new
code replaces the previous one for the same phone and purpose
- rate limiter (429): one code per phone and purpose per resend_in seconds, and per hour
at most OTP_MAX_PER_PHONE_HOUR codes per phone and OTP_MAX_PER_IP_HOUR per IP
post.summary: sends a one-time code by SMS

parameters.description: where and why to send the code
parameters.name: body

post.description:
- phone_number and purpose must be the ones the code was sent for; code is 6 digits (422)
- a matching code is deleted, so it works only once; data is null
- wrong code: 422 with the attempts left; after OTP_MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS wrong codes the
code is deleted and the answer is 429
- no code (never sent, expired after 2 minutes, or already used): 404

error_note.example: limit must be a positive integer
phone number is not verified, verify a sign_up code with /v1/otp/verify first
a code was sent recently, request a new one in 42 seconds

expires_in.description: seconds until the access token expires

resend_in.description: seconds until a new code may be requested
